items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I brought a band from -- I picked up another band in Washington... Marlo Morris was on piano.

ctx.x: Only on 52nd Street. The Downbeat, you know, almost -- that's the spot, only place to work around New York at that particular time, and I brought a band from -- I picked up another band in Washington, some guys, and I went to Chicago, and I told you this too the other night, and that was John Malachi and Tommy Potter and -- who the heck else was on that band there? Marlo Morris was on piano. I don't know if you ever heard of him, but he played good.
Hey done a lot of records.
